en_title: Johnny Depp Is Open to Playing Jack Sparrow Again in a New Pirates of the Caribbean Movie
cn_title: Johnny Depp愿意在新的《Pirates of the Caribbean》电影中再次饰演Jack Sparrow
opus_summary: Johnny Depp表示愿意在新的《Pirates of the Caribbean》电影中再次饰演Jack Sparrow，希望以更好的方式为系列收尾。制片人Jerry Bruckheimer此前称曾与他商谈新片，但尚未敲定任何安排，剧本正在创作中。

paragraphs.en: Johnny Depp is open to playing Jack Sparrow again in a new Pirates of the Caribbean movie, despite saying he'd never work with Disney on the franchise ever again.
paragraphs.cn: Johnny Depp愿意在新的《Pirates of the Caribbean》电影中再次饰演Jack Sparrow，尽管他曾表示再也不会在该系列中与Disney合作。

paragraphs.en: In a recent interview with Entertainment Tonight , Depp was asked if he had any interest in playing Sparrow again. He noted that he wanted to send the franchise off on a better note, presumably referring to the last film being a critical disappointment.
paragraphs.cn: 在最近接受《Entertainment Tonight》采访时，Depp被问到是否有兴趣再次饰演Sparrow。他表示希望让该系列以更好的方式收尾，想必指的是上一部电影未能获得影评界好评。

paragraphs.en: "If things are exactly where they need to be with regard to how they're going to top off the Pirates [story]. The only involvement I really want to have, truly, is just to send them off on a better note. I'll go to work with [Jerry] Bruckheimer tomorrow for anything. If it's Jerry, I trust him. We have a deep friendship."
paragraphs.cn: 「如果他们为《Pirates》［故事］收尾的方式一切都恰如其分。说真的，我真正想做的只是参与其中，让他们以更好的方式收尾。无论是什么项目，我明天就愿意和［Jerry］Bruckheimer合作。如果是Jerry，我信任他。我们有着深厚的友谊。」

paragraphs.en: Depp had previously stated during his legal battle with Amber Heard that he wouldn't work with Disney on a new Pirates movie , not even for $300 million and a million alpaca. It seems he's softened his stance on the matter, which has reportedly been the case for a while. Producer Jerry Bruckheimer has stated a few times over the last couple of years that he was having conversations with Depp about a new Pirates movie , but nothing has been locked in place. There is, however, a screenplay in the works , and the producer hopes to get a deal signed with Depp.
paragraphs.cn: Depp此前在与Amber Heard的法律纠纷期间表示，他不会与Disney合作拍摄新的《Pirates》电影，即使给他3亿美元和100万只羊驼也不行。看来他在这件事上的立场已经软化，据报道，这种情况已有一段时间。制片人Jerry Bruckheimer在过去几年里曾多次表示，他正在与Depp商谈新的《Pirates》电影，但尚未敲定任何事。不过，剧本正在创作中，制片人希望能与Depp签署协议。

paragraphs.en: This is the first time Depp has publicly revealed he's open to the idea since swearing off the idea in 2023. Disney had also been exploring a new Pirates of the Caribbean movie with Margot Robbie in the lead role, but that has yet to make any kind of notable progress. Depp hasn't been in many blockbuster roles since his legal battle with Heard, and he was notably forced to step down from his role in the Fantastic Beasts films due to his libel case against UK outlet The Sun. He was replaced by actor Mads Mikkelsen for the third film in the franchise, which also happened to be the last.
paragraphs.cn: 这是Depp自2023年发誓不再考虑这个想法以来，首次公开表示愿意考虑。Disney此前也一直在探索由Margot Robbie主演新的《Pirates of the Caribbean》电影，但至今尚未取得任何明显进展。自与Heard的法律纠纷以来，Depp鲜少出演大片角色，值得注意的是，他因与英国媒体《The Sun》之间的诽谤诉讼而被迫退出《Fantastic Beasts》电影中的角色。在该系列的第三部电影中，演员Mads Mikkelsen接替了他，而这部电影也恰好是该系列的最后一部。

paragraphs.en: Deep is now set to star in a new take on A Christmas Carol with the film Ebenezer , which releases on November 13. Whether Jack Sparrow will set sail again remains to be seen, but he does appear to be more into the idea than he was before.
paragraphs.cn: Depp现已确定主演电影《Ebenezer》，这是一部对《A Christmas Carol》的全新演绎，将于11月13日上映。Jack Sparrow是否会再次扬帆起航还有待观察，但Depp看起来确实比以前更愿意考虑这个想法了。
